timeout_note: Finalize using development model probe, freeze before held-out evaluation. Timeout may leave server inference running; no automatic uncertain retry.
selection_rule: Development only: maximize proxy recall at 20s, then 5s; ties minimize logical requests then encoded bytes. Chosen before testing, explicitly exploratory.
timely_definition: A spatially matched prediction must return no later than both the event start plus deadline and the visibility end.
stale_definition: On each 1Hz tick a retained matched observation is stale if its derived object visibility event has ended; D withdraws source frames at its configured TTL. Report unknown ticks and answer coverage alongside stale ticks.
cache_policy: Cache key includes image SHA256 and full frozen model contract plus timeout/retry settings. Replay uses recorded original HTTP latency. New real calls and replays reported separately.
latency_claim: real HTTP request driven offline causal replay, not original-speed live camera measurement
cost_claim: local fixed model API charges are zero; do not calculate API cost saving percentage or infer electricity savings
